benchmark_selection_basis: simulator-only validity; no FastWAM inference has been run on any move_block_reveal_can version
bug_classification: pre-policy scripted-expert transfer-path correction only; task scene, sampling, conditions, seeds, camera, horizon, visibility, instruction, and success predicate are unchanged from V0.3
reason: V0.3.7 passed the complete reset/paired-state/visibility audit, but its scripted expert failed all 9 seed-condition cells. Physical traces showed a common path defect: the fixed +0.080 m pre-insertion waypoint left the held can 0.0719-0.0760 m below the complete basket upper AABB, so the path intersected the handle or pushed the basket. V0.3.8 derives a high-transfer waypoint from the live can and basket world AABBs, moves vertically at the source, horizontally only after obtaining 0.020 m full-AABB clearance, then inserts vertically to the unchanged V0.3.7 functional lane. This is an expert-only correction made before any FastWAM run.
instruction: Put the can into the basket.

occluder.implementation: one dynamic rigid actor with procedural opaque body and grasp cap, matching visual/collision geometry

conditions.shared_base: all conditions construct and settle the block at occluding_pose through the same fixed-seed path
conditions.visible: before first policy observation, move only block to revealed_pose, zero velocity, advance five physics steps
conditions.missing: leave block at occluding_pose, advance the same five physics steps, no intervention
conditions.oracle_reveal: start exactly as missing; before first policy observation apply the exact visible block-only intervention

visibility.missing: zero can pixels independently in head, left wrist, and right wrist
visibility.visible_and_oracle: at least one policy camera contains at least 32 can pixels
visibility.block: at least 32 pixels in at least one policy camera

task_configuration.success: can projected full AABB laterally contained by basket metadata bounds; can center vertically inside conservative placement range; basket upright; can contacts basket; can-side gripper open; can contacts neither gripper; relative can/basket motion below fixed thresholds for 25 actual physics steps; block ignored; check_success pure

scripted_expert.visible_and_oracle: native grasp, AABB-audited source lift and high transfer, unchanged functional-lane insertion, release, reverse vertical retreat, home, persistent settle
scripted_expert.missing: compound block reveal, direct return home, then the identical can path used by visible/oracle
scripted_expert.meaningful_contact: any point with signed separation <= 0 or applied impulse norm > 0
scripted_expert.can_insertion_target: choose the native functional point nearest the post-grasp EE; local horizontal target is basket center + 0.75 * (functional point - basket center); local vertical center = conservative interior-floor envelope + projected can half-height + 0.005 m; orientation and EE-to-can grasp transform preserved

exact_block_reveal_calibration.instruction: Move the block aside to reveal the can.
exact_block_reveal_calibration.success: same frozen Missing scene/block; block translated >=0.08 m, can visible, block released and not in meaningful contact with can, block stable for 25 physics steps; can placement not scored

evaluation_plan_frozen_before_fastwam.admission_rule: after simulator audits and runtime freeze pass, run both calibrations once; run paired pilot only if both thresholds pass; never alter frozen task from policy observations

gpu_protocol.guard: before every launch save full nvidia-smi, compute-app, and pmon; refuse any target GPU containing non-Xorg activity
gpu_protocol.isolation: SAPIEN by PCI; CUDA by ordered UUIDs; bubblewrap exposes only selected NVIDIA/DRI nodes
gpu_protocol.fastwam_device: cuda:1 inside ordered [simulator UUID, policy UUID] CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES

v0_3_7_evidence.main_scripted_expert: 0/9 condition cells and 0/27 attempts; deterministic held-can/basket transfer-path defect

pre_policy_validation_required.calibration_scripted_expert: all five native downstream and all five exact reveal seeds have a fixed-seed witness
